description: Implementation of Telemetry functionality including report uploading, privacy mode handling, and configuration management within a WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry functionalities, including configuration, event handling, and report management.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the service, sets up power management and privacy mode.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for telemetry events.

methods.name: SetReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the report profile ('STARTED' or 'COMPLETE').

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with a name and value.

methods.name: UploadReport
methods.description: Triggers the upload of telemetry report via RBus.

methods.name: SetOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets the telemetry opt-out status in a file.

methods.name: IsOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Reads the telemetry opt-out status from a file.
